notes.title: AD WARS v0.4.7 - DOUBLE UPDATE OUT NOW + STEAM DECK LAUNCH!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ad Hunters, our new Double Update is OUT NOW! 🌙[/h3][p][/p][p]Why do we call it a Double Update? Because we merged 2 feature updates into one: the [b]Download City Update[/b] and the [b]Vortex Zone Update[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]So, as you might guess, this Update is PACKED with new content. Let's get started:[/p][p][/p][h1]Download City[/h1][p]Introducing Download City, a sci-fi metropolis with five unique districts to explore. Each one brings its own flavor, secrets, and challenges:[/p][list][*][p][b]Southern District[/b] – The starting area, home to the [b]Access Point[/b] and the [b]DNS[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Central District[/b] – Featuring [b]Routing Station[/b], where all Internet Downloads come from.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eastern District[/b] – Once safe… now ruled by criminals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Western District[/b] – The corporate side of the City.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Northern District[/b] – A secret for now... 👀[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/d7befe69f7c5e8dd91960909bffc0b22c6deb0b8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Agent Silver[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/747eb973b38df69c6222638dbe0fe361deac7b36.png"][/img][/p][p]In this episode, Alt and Magna become Detectives and join forces with none other than [b]Agent Silver Havoc[/b] to hunt down criminals and put an end to the Ads flooding the City.[/p][p][/p][p]Silver is more than just an ally – she’ll fight alongside you, pick up weapons and items, and unleash her unique Ethereal powers. As an Ethereal, she can even possess enemy robots, turning their strength against them.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll also be able to control Silver directly to solve split-character puzzles. For example, you might need Alt to hold one pressure switch while Silver activates another, opening paths that would otherwise remain locked.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pipes[/h2][p]How do people travel around Download city? Pipes![/p][p]Since Download City is all about downloads, their travel system should be around transporting packages.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/e89312e526faa69d5cb0732efdf51577613681e4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Area: Department of National Security (DNS)[/h2][p]The police headquarters of Download City. Here, you’ll step into the role of a detective, piecing together clues and advancing the city’s storylines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/6131600f7074e8729a08316501cde738d0c0dd27.png"][/img][/p][p]We added a Story mission to this level that takes place after the events of Access Point. In this mission you will learn the true Story about Ethereals and why it's difficult to solve crimes in Download City.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Area: Routing Station[/h2][p]The central story mission of this episode and the Central Building in all Download City.
[/p][p]Routing Station processes all the downloads and routes them to all of the Internet.
[/p][p]Alt and Silver finally join forces to uncover the mastermind flooding the internet with Ads hidden inside downloads.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/134b53482ce1b93a5cfd10c553ae065e96fad0db.png"][/img][/p][p]This level heavily revolves around pipes, boxes, packages and also introduces the unique abilities of Agent Silver![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/392318293406a53ae8e0d858d884b9fc47fa6d0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Little secret: beating this level unlocks a series of side-quests.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Area: Download City Interiors[/h2][p]Many buildings in Download City now have [b]interiors[/b], where you might find several Side Quests, Shops, hidden goodies and maybe even an [b]Internet Vortex[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/e201381f94ca381e816fbc73953860ffb6ce67b2.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Area: Abandoned Buildings[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/3ab963c5205317805fe73b82a2cc36eddd1c714f.png"][/img][/p][p]We wanted to add some challenge maps for this genre, where you fight waves of enemies. Be prepared for a tough fight, and be prepared to catch many criminals![/p][p][/p][h2]Criminals (Ethereal Enemies)[/h2][p]Enemy Ethereals can posses other enemies and make them stronger! To capture an enemy you will need to use the New Capture Disc Gun to launch a Capture Disc (CD).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Vortex Zone[/h1][p]This myterious new area acts as a secret hub to the entire game.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting this update, some levels will have secret Vortexes that you unlock by completing puzzles, quests or using weapons and spells.[/p][p][/p][p]Some Vortexes you unlock conect back to the Vortex Zone. As you unlock more Vortexes, you will unlock secret passages between all 3 main areas of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/e68b373718b8f886cdf0505034c4c0990217967a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/5770669143ac5b9938132de9111de9cc2a8e7cc2.png"][/img][/p][h1]Steam Deck Support[/h1][p]We've been working for a long time to make Ad Wars fully compatible with the Steam Deck. This release will get it's own article, don't worry.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/2559268f50958526c7a171c95237062d549c1f6a.png"][/img][/p][p]To make it work on a smaller screen we had to do some things:[/p][list][*][p]A better scaling system so it looks good on any display[/p][/*][*][p]Make the UI Scale Responsive[/p][/*][*][p]Test the entire game to make sure the camera never misses anything special.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We can finally say that Ad Wars fully works on the Deck so well that we end up forgetting about testing and we get lost playing around the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope that's your case too![/p][p][/p][h1]New Feature: Damage Elements[/h1][p]Throughout the game, you will find weapons, spells and debuffs of these elements:[/p][list][*][p]Fire[/p][/*][*][p]Water[/p][/*][*][p]Poison[/p][/*][*][p]Electric[/p][/*][*][p]Ice[/p][/*][*][p]Ground / Rock[/p][/*][/list][p]You can see those types in the RPG Battle system too, with the trends system, where you get bonus damage if you use a trendy attack element![/p][p][/p][p]We're working on adding specific types of Obstacles that need specific types of elements to destroy.[/p][p][/p][h1]Enemies[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Enemy: Elemental Fire[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/1177067e739f19205433422cfc7c537bc0a82a59.gif"][/img][/p][p]The next step after we added [b]Damage Elements [/b]was adding an enemy that also played around with those types, so we introduced the Elemental Fire, which you can find in many areas of the game.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Feature: Enemy Tiers[/h2][p][/p][p]Enemies now have a new property: Tier. A Higher Tier means the enemy is smarter, deals more damage and has new attacks.[/p][p][/p][p]Tiers are indicated by the Enemy Color. If you see a Purple Spider, it means it's a Tier 2 Spider and doesn't roam around anymore, but runs straight to the player and shoots bullets, so watch out![/p][p][/p][h2]New Enemy: Aimed Turrets[/h2][p][/p][p]Back in v0.4.4 we introduced Turrets in the very first level, but they were static and were easy to avoid.[/p][p][/p][p]With the new enemy tiers, we made rotating turrets that make up for a tough fight![/p][p][/p][h2]New Enemy: Mimic Boxes[/h2][p][/p][p]We won't spoil much of Routing Station, but we finally added these enemies to the game. They've been around for years.[/p][p][/p][h2]Thermal Goo & Flies in Platformer[/h2][p][/p][p]We wanted to make some global enemies, making them appear in every episode, and what's better than the Thermal Goo for that![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/3eb6fe09f14a84151f8154d0f4e5ede375c13a2e.png"][/img][/p][p]We also added the Robot Flies from the Shooter into Platformer.[/p][p][/p][h1]Spells[/h1][p]Starting this update Magna steps in with 4 different spells to cast. You can now cast them mid battle. This opens up the gameplay, as you can effectively now shoot and cast a spell at the same time.[/p][p]In our previous update we had the Shield Spell and the Fire Spell, now we also added 2 new spells:[/p][p][/p][h2]Ice Spell I[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/8cef8333491d4fc7bd5671261cb1633f076bcb00.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Thunder Spell I[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/a290ad3d6a7eb8bfb422c14fcb41cb73cf3c385d.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Spell Upgrades[/h2][p]Spells can be upgraded by using Upgrade Points. This will make them deal more damage, cast faster, and add unique traits, but know that it will make them use more Magic Points (which can be upgraded too!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/9417ea8a3f12b6aa4b25b1beb0ef2cea0e607c92.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Weapons[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Weapon: Capture Disc Gun[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapon: Turret head[/h2][p]Just like the broken Robot Arm in the First Level, we wanted to add a weapon that drops as part of a defeated enemy, and now that Enemy Turrets have a more important role it was a great time to add a small chance to drop the turret itself as a reward weapon.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapon: Icethrower[/h2][p]An Ice Cannon that quickly shoots Ice Crystals that may Freeze Enemies![/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapon: Rocket Launcher[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Upgrades[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now upgrade Weapons too! Another great way of your Upgrade Points, and another reason to destroy more ads![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/51174687b256cd764c7bc8ac1d497c5fee13a7d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Some examples of weapon upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Add poison to the Water Gun, to add a chance to poison enemies![/p][/*][*][p]Chance to throw more than one Knife at a time[/p][/*][*][p]Improve [/p][/*][/list][h1]Bomwat v2[/h1][p]We finally got to re-do one of the oldest characters in the game, Bomwat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/5ee9d77ed52cc9d3087c4bf95b67a593aec94cf1.gif"][/img][/p][p]This is not on the update, but we're also working to make more puzzles that involve Alt's and Bomwat's ability to carry objects.[/p][p][/p][h1]AdBlue Platformer v2[/h1][p]This was looooong overdue, but since we first introduced AdBlue in our first Steam Release, we were missing a proper background for the Platformer section.[/p][p]We're glad to say that's in the past know![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/ac1b4157e05bbe79ace4a09c7de6a395e077b46b.png"][/img][/p][h1]Platformer Caves v2[/h1][p]This one was supposed to be in a Patch of v0.4.5, but got delayed and eventually made it to this update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/e0b3dd6bd01d4cf2e828afde29fc091c9b5696ee.png"][/img][/p][p]We added parallaxed layers to all 3 versions of caves (Normal, Ice and Forest Caves).[/p][p][/p][h1]Platformer Physics Objects[/h1][p]In order to improve the Platformer, we wanted to add decorations that interact with Alt, that you could also destroy, so we added Cave Vines, Ropes, Mushrooms that hang to other objects and you can cut![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/c3706b4a80d6b062b3851b4efdb4de856a51e8e7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/097e603cd6f1bd7ba1685fa5c6c9de0472b6c2ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now! Hopefully you now know why this update took [b]so long[/b] to make. We're really happy with the results, and even happier that we're connecting the entire Ad Wars universe through the Internet Vortexes and some Side-Quests that we added.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, we're going to work on many [b]patches[/b] that fix bugs, polish some things and add some goodies while we work on our next big update.[/p][p][/p][p]If you find any bugs / glitches or want to request any features, you can do so in our Forum Posts.[/p][p][/p][p]Have Fun and blast ads![/p][p][b]aGlitch, Moon Snack Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: Ad Wars v0.4.7 Update Announcement + Steam Deck Support!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Ad Hunters! 🌙[/p][p][/p][p]After months of hard work, we're back with a [b]Double Update![/b] We ended up combining updates v0.4.6 and v0.4.7, which now means there are tons of new content for this update, with the main focus being [b]Download City[/b] and the [b]Vortex Zone[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The update launches this [b]Thursday, August 28[/b]![/p][previewyoutube="TlhXlHJkbvk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Download City[/h1][p]Welcome to Download City – a massive hub with five unique districts to explore. Each one brings its own flavor, secrets, and challenges.[/p][p]Previously players only had access to a small starting area and the level Access Point, but starting this update you will gain access to the entire city, with [b]6 total new areas to explore, 2 of which have story missions.[/b][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/d7befe69f7c5e8dd91960909bffc0b22c6deb0b8.png"][/img][/h2][h2]Agent Silver[/h2][p]And this time, you’re not alone.[/p][p][b]Silver joins you throughout this episode[/b], helping you investigate crimes across Download City. In combat, she fights by your side, picks up items, and can even shift into her [b]Ethereal form[/b] to capture and control enemy robots.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/3bd48a9c4ba3a9ac92b90558da6a47c4d76bc1b4.png"][/img][/p][h1]Vortex Zone[/h1][p]A mysterious new area that connects the [b]secrets of the entire internet[/b]. You’ll find a new overworld entrance, plus multiple hidden entrances scattered across older levels.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/e68b373718b8f886cdf0505034c4c0990217967a.png"][/img][/p][h1]Spells[/h1][p]Starting this update Magna steps in with 4 different spells to cast. You can now cast them mid battle. This opens up the gameplay, as you can effectively now shoot and cast a spell at the same time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/8cef8333491d4fc7bd5671261cb1633f076bcb00.gif"][/img][/p][h1]Steam Deck Support[/h1][p]We've been working for a long time to make Ad Wars fully compatible with the Steam Deck. This release will get it's own article, don't worry.[/p][p][/p][p]We can finally say that Ad Wars fully works on the Deck, and it's really addictive to play on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/2559268f50958526c7a171c95237062d549c1f6a.png"][/img][/p][p]See you all this Thursday![/p][p] [/p][p][b]aGlitch, Moon Snack Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Ad Wars Game Reboot (v0.4.4 Lost Changelog)
notes.notes:
Hey Ad Hunters! First I wanted to say [b][u]sorry[/u][/b] that it took so long for me to finish this changelog.

After each update, I tend to work a lot on fixing current issues, and this update changed the game so much that it also introduced new things to fix. After that we were behind schedule for the new content, so I rushed to work on update v0.4.5. Hopefully by the end of this changelog you will get an idea of HOW BIG this update was to the entire game.

Without further ado, let's get into it!

[h2]New Level: The Adpocalypse[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/80ab382e67b5bfd663f5875eff66812266efe329.png[/img]

When I first created the game, it started with the bullet hell genre but we had a problem with it: it was TOO HARD for new players. Some players ended up [u]dropping[/u] the game before playing the multiple game genres! It was a really difficult decision to made, so we ended up discarding the Bullet Hell and it's 3 levels.

But it's not lost: we're going to make a new game / mini-game out of the lost levels in the future.

After discarding the Bullet Hell, we re-made the whole city level into a Top Down Shooter level that sort of acted as a tutorial first, then it opens up so you can almost instantly start exploring at your own will.

This new level is called "The Adpocalypse" for the disaster that kickstarts the game story. Alt's mission is to get to the AdBlue building.

As we scrapped the old Bullet Hell Level 2, we wanted to bring The Gatekeeper to this level, it ended up working as the first boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/21f7370ad24ecf58759488a081052c473888de86.jpg[/img]

Also: back in march we attended to our first game event, and we were lucky that we got to live test this level. People had a lot of fun with it and the level boss, so we knew we were on the right track.

[h2]Vs Combo Bosses[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/f8455e83133babc72666a38484e5a9194554a07f.jpg[/img]

The old Combo battle was a Bullet Hell level with 4 bosses, so we had to re-do it as well.

It's now broken up into 3 separate battles: Burger (RPG), Fries + Soda (Platformer) and the Mighty Ice Cream (Top Down Shooter).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/4bf35c1a847af6dd34f8d4950ea128df45ab81d7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/2a9f7df3316e9418009faf241e95bc0a6f8e4fdc.png[/img]

We also re-made the Internet Portal and made a new cutscene that introduces the New Combo Bosses and wraps the Intro episode of the game.

[h2]Construct 3 Migration + Entire Project Optimization[/h2]

When we first made our game, I used Construct 2 as our engine, as it felt like it provided the freedom to make a multi-genre game. But, after years went by, it felt that we were stuck with really old features, and the performance was starting to show it's age. So we had to upgrade.

It took some time, because we had to port the entire game, delete plugins, and dish out really old code. 

Thanks to the new engine features I was able to optimize the game code A LOT. This + the new engine (which is tons faster too) made a night / day difference in terms of performance. I cannot stress how big of a difference it ended up making. It felt (feels) like a new game, and now I can work on new features faster.

An example of a major improvement is that now the game is [b]fully responsive[/b]! It will scale up / down according to your display. Gone are the days of scaling issues!

[h2]Gameplay UI Reboot[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/1759bfca665bd0885e86a1b159d310f474cecb09.png[/img]

Back when we made the pause menu / inventory system, it was already clear that we needed to re-do our  Gameplay UI. It was a debt we had with the project for a couple of years.

You can now see your current weapon (Sword), your equipped item (or Spell), your Health Points (red), your Magic Points (Green) and the Weapon Durability (Yellow circle around the weapon).

[h3]Boss GUI[/h3]

This was part of the new Gameplay GUI. We re-made the Boss Lifebar with the new visual theme.

Also, whenever you fight a boss, there's a new GUI that shows the boss position even when it's out of the screen, so you can keep track of it's position.

[h3]Notifications[/h3]

Tiny pop-ups that show up whenever you pick an item / weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/d156863686f6c556fe8c104533fa984a1e51590b.png[/img]

[h2]Big Feature: Upgrade System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/b9212567f4f134a0caa4e507b7a931e542bae2e6.png[/img]

In Ad Wars you destroy ads. Destroying ads give you Upgrade Points.

What can you do with your precious Upgrade Points? You can now purchase upgrades at any Checkpoint System to enhance your abilities. This can vary from a much needed permanent Health Upgrade to more base damage to your Sword and Blaster!

This is a core mechanic to the game, and the entire game has been reshaped to spin it around finding hidden ads.

[h2]Accessories[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/0753b67a6c0bf4d91a4f7d46143881cf6ac9dbb6.png[/img]

You can now find and purchase accesories, which get you non-permanent upgrades that sometimes work context-wise like resistance to Ice damage (which helps you in the Ice Cream Boss Battle by the way), other times they enhance abilities like giving Platformer Alt more Jump height.

You can equip a limited amount of accessories at a time, using Accessory Points (which can be upgraded by destroying ads and using the respective Upgrade Points).

[h2]Fast Weapon Swap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/56738350e4ad889426064619ef6584ea1fc494f2.gif[/img]

Throughout your adventure you will find lots of weapons, spells and items to use. Before, you had to open up the pause menu, switch tabs to your inventory and equip it. While you can still do that, you can also use the shoulder buttons to quickly swap between your current weapons. This made the combat much faster.

[h2]Spells[/h2]

Spells are a secondary type of weapon that you can use at any time that have many effects like protecting yourself, attacking rows of enemies, staling enemies and more! We're also working on special obstacles where you need to use the spells to unlock your way through (ie special ice block that you destroy with the Fire Spell).

The first 2 spells are the Shield Spell and the Fire spell.

Shield Spell

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/627cc223f596085eb3aa3a13eb0b8dd212735e2d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/00bef3b763157e3471ffd7364a994d09ff2af558.gif[/img]

The Shield Spell creates an orbitting sphere that protects you from damage and also damages enemies. you can spawn 2 at a time, but you will be able to upgrade it in the future, so it can withstand more damage and other effects like exploding when it gets destroyed.

Fire Spell

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/9fc94a4a0df5e2869cc40285decf66547131241f.gif[/img]

The fire spell launches a powerful ball of fire that goes through enemies and also burns them, dealing extra damage.

[h2]RPG Battle Item weapons + New UI[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/ac77952c975633166e8f600fb507f1e41de04b95.png[/img]

You can now use weapons from all other genres into RPG Battles! Some weapons like bombs attack every enemy on the battlefield.

Others, like the Electric Gun deal Electric damage and are able to stun enemies as well!

You can also use any Spells that you find around, like the Shield Spell.

To integrate this new feature, we redesigned the entire RPG Battle UI, it's now shinier than ever.

[h2]Level Select Screen v2[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/4840b3a368f3e2708e0385fe9ffa207386e7cb86.png[/img]

While the whole game grew, the Level Select screen was left behind, it didn't help keep track of your current collectibles, so we decided to re-do it from scratch.

[h2]Rocket Launcher + Revolver[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/d1574231eae62804fbb07795a3b5dd8a94a06218.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/d1574231eae62804fbb07795a3b5dd8a94a06218.gif[/img]

Who can say no to a bunch of new weapons?

[h2]Joystick movement redone[/h2]

We heard the complains loud and clear, you were absolutely right about joystick movement! I've now re-made the Gamepad Joystick movement from scratch. It now uses direct axis inputs for smooth control.

[h2]Platformer / Shooter Enemy AI Revamp[/h2]

All enemies in the game now use a line of sight system where they can be alerted or go back to idle. You can tell it because they will either pop out an "!" or "?" symbol. They are smarter and more fun to fight.

[h2]Full screen tutorials[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/1ec9198fa1392fbe4fc73f32945a1f6362d76c8e.png[/img]

Ad Wars is a complex game. There are lots of mechanics that need to be explained to players, and sometimes it was overwhelming. We introduced full-screen tutorials with videos to make it a better experience.

We're also working on a section on the Pause Menu where you can check back all the Tutorials any time you need (TBA).

[h2]Zoom[/h2]

You can now toggle zoom in / out by pressing Backspace on the Keyboard, and Select on a Controller. It's specially helpful on bigger screens.

[h2]Platformer Respawn System v2[/h2]

Previously, if you fell off the stage or landed on a Spike, you respawned at a set location, which caused problems with open ended levels, like Convenience Store, where you're running left to right at times, and right to left at others.

You now respawn at an invisible checkpoint that is near the falling pit / spike.

More Features:

-Platformer Camera shakes whenever you stomp an enemy, get hit and destroy boxes
-You can now use Bombs in Top Down Shooter and RPG!
-New Songs for Hero Village! (Credits to the great Yemmie)
-Map Names / Quest Status Updates Fix
-Adblue Platformer: Added a Walljump Tutorial Room Before the Cracker Fight

There are tons of small / tiny features and improvements everywhere in the game that are not listed here.

We feel like this update ended up the research phase of the project. All loose ends tied, major features all working together into a cohesive experience.

I really mean it when I say that I hope this is the version of the game you get to play.

Thanks for all the love and support, 

aGlitch

notes.title: AD WARS v0.4.5 UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello Ad Hunters, HAPPY HALLOWEEN!

And what better way to celebrate than a monster-filled update! Ad Wars v0.4.5 is here, packed with new content and improvements to the overall game.

Trailer:

[previewyoutube=3rZ66WphqUw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Metro Town[/h1]

notes.title: AD WARS v0.4.4 - A MAJOR UPDATE IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hey Ad Hunters, we're finally back with another update! But this is not just your regular content update...

This one is a major re-engineering of the entire game. First, we migrated the entire project to Construct 3, which itself is miles ahead of the previous version, and that triggered mejor re-structuring of the project.

[previewyoutube=wmWa5watgxE;full][/previewyoutube]

We also wanted to leave behind the old first level, because it made players drop the game before actually discovering it's true nature. So we set up to re-create the intro in a much better fasion, with gameplay at it's core. The result is the new level called "The Adpocalypse" which is the starting point of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/80ab382e67b5bfd663f5875eff66812266efe329.png[/img]

I also attended my first ever event back in march from which I took a lot of great feedback. We decided to delay this update in order to implement those changes (it was supposed to be released in march).

The full changelist would be endless by the amount of things we re-did, but I'm going to post a changelog in the upcoming days with the most important changes and the process behind them.

Keypoints:
-New Engine migration (over 200% better performance, lots of re-ingeering)
-New Story Level (The Adpocalypse)
-Much better enemy AI (all genres)
-New Bosses
-Major project Cleanup
-Multi-Genre Weapons (all weapons in all genres)
-Fast Weapon Swap
-Universal Game Variables across all genres (HP / MP)
-Equipment
-New UI

We're really happy with how it turned out to be. Once again, I'll go deeper into explaining some of the changes in the next log.

For now, we hope you have fun blasting those nasty ads!

aGlitch

notes.title: New Content Update (v0.4.3) OUT NOW! (Full changelog)
notes.notes:
Hey Ad Hunters! We're back with another big content update. This time you'll get to explore the haunted kingdom of Metro. We also made big changes to the game overall, added new requested features, improved several maps and much more. Let's get started!

[h1]Trailer[/h1]

[previewyoutube=HXTzMPGSOuY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Features[/h1]

[h2]New Game Areas[/h2]

[h3]Metro Forest North[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/742f898c487c56270194cd202efed0b1a3eb1d65.png[/img]

[h3]Clickbait Castle Entrance[/h3]

[h3]Clickbait Fields North[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/293ef7a43ef6c7f59ed96e4a3536cafe6039dc22.png[/img]

[h3]New Intro Room[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/a9adc84fab0a39175f122998b5652ed429b4cff6.gif[/img]

[h2]HP / MP System integration[/h2]

One major problem with the game was the lack of integrations between the game genres. It made the experience feel like different games taped into a package because it didn't have many mechanics built across them.

So, in order to unify the genres into a more cohesive experience, the first step is to unify all HP / MP values into just one parameter.

[h2]Ads[/h2]

[previewyoutube=fBz5v4A7VqY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Shooting in the RPG[/h2]

You can now shoot enemies in the RPG overworld to temporarily stun them, giving you the chance to avoid some battles.

We also added a bunch of destructable objects to shoot at.

[h2]Crowdies[/h2]

A new type of "collectible" exclusive to Clickbait Kingdom (RPG). Finding a Crowdie will get you a Crescent Stone, which will be used in the future in exchange for something great!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/a25da75b593c4b25eae3c8e42eb25feb4f699bee.gif[/img]

[h2]RPG[/h2]

[h3]RPG fast travel[/h3]

RPG Checkpoints have been completely changed in this update: they now feature Fast Travel between the different checkpoints inside a map, and an option to access the Upgrade (Rank Points) Menu.

You can also drop down from the overworld to any Checkpoint (same as it was in the Platformer)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/8426a10e8d6f49f26bb737ed0eadfcafd1f74f47.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now run in the RPG overworld to explore the world as a faster pace
[*] Metro region OW
[*] RPG exit from any point
[*] RPG OW indicators
[*] New RPG Enemy Pathfinding
[*] RPG Breakable objects (boxes, crates and skulls)
[*] Breakable objects in Clickbait Castle, Clickbait Town, Clickbait Fields South and AdBlue RPG
[/list]

[h2]Ship[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41033550/1cf4070ed6a540689a7fa9a569298fbbb927905d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We redesigned Alt's sprite from scratch, with new animations
[*] You can now run in the Ship (same as the RPG)
[*] We also redesigned Alt's ship chair with special animations
[*] You can now find the Upgrade Menu (Rank Points) on the top left PC
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]

[h3]Controller Consistency[/h3]

One of the main criticisms about the game was the lack of consistency of inputs between genres. We now changed some of the default inputs so they are consistent.

[list]
[*] In the roguelike genre you couldn't shoot with a button, so now you can shoot in the same direction Alt is shooting by pressing the shoot button
[*] Running in the RPG / Ship now uses the same button
[*] All genres use the same button to swap between weapons
[*] All other genre-specific actions use the same button (Bomwat in the platformer, dashing in the Roguelike)
[/list]

[h3]Steam Overlay Fix[/h3]

We finally fixed the Steam Overlay! It had some issues regarding the game engine that we're using.

[h2]Roguelike[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shooting with the shoot button (Controller consistency)
[*] Alt now blinks when you get low health
[/list]

[h2]Platformer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new sprite on top of the Air currents that makes it look much better
[*] Hero Village now features a complete new song by Yemmie
[*] Explosions now create a light object (you can see it by exploding a bomb in a cave)
[*] Alt now blink's when you're on low health
[/list]

[h2]AdBlue[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rank Points Explanation
[*] Upgrade (Rank Points) PC
[*] AdBlue Roguelike Ads
[*] AdBlue Rpg Ads
[*] AdBlue Platformer ads
[/list]

[h2]Patch 1 Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hp values
[*] Magna not updating HP / MP
[*] Upgrade menu fix
[*] Checkpoint Menu fix (it was aligned to the left)
[*] Quacky cream fix
[*] RPG enemy stun particles
[/list]
(special thanks to Northdream for reporting these bugs!)

That's all for now! As usual, we'll keep on releasing Patches as we find bugs or we improve some things out. We're already working on update 0.4.4, which will feature masive changes for the entire game.

If you happen to find any bugs, you can open a thread on our discussions or DM us through social media.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Welcome Post & Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam! aGlitch here, main developer of Ad Wars. I'm super happy to be here on Steam, finally releasing the store page and the free demo for Ad Wars!

[h1]Demo Time![/h1]

Ad Wars is planned to be a really long game, which will be divided into different episodes (within the same game). So, to properly introduce all the main story and gameplay elements, we decided to launch the entire intro episode for free!

As for today, we just released a the patch Demo F1, which has lots of changes and fixes! More on that below!

[h1]Our plans[/h1]

We're planning on releasing more patches for this demo, featuring both fixes, polishes and also upgrades (like graphics and efects) based on your feedback!

At the same time, we are also working on bringing in the full version of the game, which will work as an early access (more on that coming soon). This new version is also referred as "the big update" because it will feature close to 4 hours of gameplay!

And lastly, there's the never ending lookout for new players, curators, reviewers and streamers. If you're looking for a different game, and to help that game grow into it's full potential, consider giving Ad Wars a shot!
